realized_ratio: 7:2 subjects (77.8%:22.2%) because the dataset has 9 participants
selection_rule: Sort SHA-256(seed|subject_id) for previously unseen subjects; first two are test. Subj05 was already inspected and is forced into development.
test_isolation_rules: Do not use test force labels, events, videos, poses, or metrics for training.
Do not use test results for hyperparameter selection, thresholds, feature selection, calibration, early stopping, or model choice.
Freeze the final model and preprocessing artifacts before opening test archives.
Run the test set once for the final locked report; any later change creates a new model version and requires a new untouched test cohort.
